subject: razor shaving
title: What If You Shaved Every Day? Would It Grow Back Thicker?

scenes.text: What if you shaved every single day? Your hair wouldn't change. But it would feel like it did.
In 1928, a scientist tested the thicker-hair belief by measuring shaved hair. Colour, texture and speed stayed the same.
A 1970 study checked again: no change in hair weight, width or growth rate.
So why does stubble feel rough? Uncut hair tapers to a fine, soft tip.
A razor slices through the thick middle, leaving a blunt end that feels coarse and looks darker against your skin.
Within days it grows out and softens again. You didn't grow more hair, you just cut its tip off.

description:
What if you shaved every day? A 1928 study and a 1970 study found shaving doesn't change hair colour, thickness or growth rate.
Stubble only feels coarse because the razor cuts through the thick shaft and leaves a blunt end instead of the natural tapered tip.
